e.title: Awesome Sustainable Finance
e.summary: 可持续金融精选资源清单（Open Risk，82★）：开源软件+开放数据，ESG/可持续投资一站式
e.body: Awesome Sustainable Finance（Open Risk 维护，82★）是可持续金融的精选资源清单：聚焦支持各类可持续金融工作的开源代码（工具/库/框架）与开放数据（ESG 评级、气候数据等）。对 RIAA：ESG/可持续金融入门的导航清单——与 [[awesome-actuarial]]（同类精选）配套；保险投资侧的 ESG 相关工具可由此展开；关联 [[esg-insurance]]（保险 ESG 概念）。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：可持续金融开源软件+开放数据精选清单（82★）
e.summary_en: Curated sustainable-finance resource list (Open Risk, 82★): open-source software + open data, one-stop ESG/sustainable-investment navigation
e.summary_hk: 可持續金融精選資源清單（Open Risk，82★）：開源軟件+開放數據，ESG/可持續投資一站式
e.body_en: Awesome Sustainable Finance (maintained by Open Risk, 82★) is a curated list of sustainable-finance resources: it focuses on open-source code (tools, libraries, frameworks) supporting any kind of sustainable-finance effort and on open data useful in a sustainable-finance context (ESG ratings, climate data, etc.). For RIAA: a navigation list to get started with ESG/sustainable finance — pairs with [[awesome-actuarial]] (a sibling curated list); insurance-investment-side ESG tooling can be explored from here; related: [[esg-insurance]] (the insurance-ESG concept).
e.body_hk: Awesome Sustainable Finance（Open Risk 維護，82★）是可持續金融的精選資源清單：聚焦支持各類可持續金融工作的開源程式碼（工具/庫/框架）與開放數據（ESG 評級、氣候數據等）。對 RIAA：ESG/可持續金融入門的導航清單——與 [[awesome-actuarial]]（同類精選）配套；保險投資側的 ESG 相關工具可由此展開；關聯 [[esg-insurance]]（保險 ESG 概念）。
